scope: Bounded native provider and consumer handoffs; no cross-owner closure

consumers.meaning: Containment runs split when start or end decreases, bisect_left starts excludes equality, ends lower bound includes equality, yields payload refs in original run order. No normalization/freshness or price test.
Tail uses caller lists, checkpoint shallow copies, original output refs; prior local CP367 failure contracts retained.
Optional live.blue_lines callback only if live supplied; native batch receives full reactions, chronology, resets. Shared feedback reuses Blue/A, not a local incremental equivalence proof.
Native run builds market scope, calls prepare_pipeline_state without passing live continuation here; do not identify optional callback as observed native Blue replay. Closed-regime handling separate.
Append transaction stages bucket updates; exception replaces market views before reraising. This is separate transport rollback boundary, no assertion about external object aliases.

Collect all result reactions from state.results.values then mark original Blue lines before public filter and lifecycle output filtering. No explicit healthy filter in collection shown; internal marking does not establish lifecycle ownership.
Bridge project formation, semantic/rendered prices string conversion, deliberately null standalone stop timestamps; full line ordinal sort by reaction number, source time, kind.
Projection uses state.full_lines_by_direction with visibility.blue_lines fallback, then full ordinal map; local filter does not reassign ordinals.
Legacy serialization selects source index bounds and stringifies prices independently; receives supplied items, no validity or internal predicate in serializer itself.

prior.disposition: Native Blue/Bridge/A owner boundary preserved; caller dirty responsibility remains open.
Source semantics agree in bounded review; callback conditional and alias/freshness not globally closed.
